argv: Round 3: Live neurons' weights and fc2.bias sit at the AdamW |w|~1 cap (fc2.bias entries pinned, Adam ratio +-1), so the network is capacity-limited. With only 1-3 neurons per frequency (26 freqs), each frequency's junk terms don't cancel and memorization fills in. The clean Fourier part with ideal bias gets ~72% train acc. The 86 dead neurons get no gradient, so the optimizer cannot recruit them. Edit: revived dead neurons 1 and 5 as a clean quadrature pair at freq 30. They copy the mirror pair 12/31 with input phases rotated by +pi/4 and +pi/4+pi and output phase by +pi/2 (clipped to +-1), so 2theta junk at k=30 cancels. That is 582 entries, optimizer moments reset. The other 167 entries set the largest off-frequency residue entries (|res|>0.76) of live neurons to their main-freq+DC projection. Trials (1000 steps): bias neurons only (7 always-on neurons supplying the missing class bias) peaked at 56.5% and fell back to 55%, so I rejected them. Quad pair only gave 59.6% flat. Quad pair plus cleaning peaked at 63.5% at 200 steps and was at 61.4% at 1000 steps, drifting down slowly. Next round: add more clean neurons (about 2 per round) into existing multi-neuron frequencies, e.g. a quadrature pair for k=16 (30/81), 19 (0/87) or 22 (23/33).
